title: Prepare a strategy-card secondary
description: While another player resolves a strategy card, a follower can prepare the secondary: a private, revocable suggestion kept only on this device. When the real question opens it is shown for a one-click confirm (Review, the default) or, in Auto mode, sent after a short cancellable delay. Nothing is spent until the real decision is answered. Synthetic gallery fixtures, not captured engine states.

shots.heading: Waiting: the prepare affordance
shots.caption: Another seat is resolving Technology. The status bar says who is deciding; a small 'Prepare your secondary' chip names the card and who played it. No one else sees it, and it only appears for a follower who has not been asked yet and could pay a strategy token.

shots.heading: The prepare panel
shots.caption: Opened: the card's printed secondary, Follow or Skip, and a note that this stays on this device, spends nothing, and can be changed when the real question comes.

shots.heading: Prepared
shots.caption: Follow plus a technology picked. The 'Prepared' badge appears, the choice is saved at once, and 'Clear prepared' revokes it. The technology list is an estimate from the viewer's own technologies; the engine still chooses the payment.

shots.heading: Review before play (default): prefilled
shots.caption: The real secondary question opened. The prepared answer, validated against the options the engine actually offers, is ready: 'Prepared: Follow Technology (spends 1 strategy token)', Confirm with one click, or Choose myself.

shots.heading: Needs review
shots.caption: When the prepared answer no longer validates (here no 'yes' is offered any more), nothing is pre-filled or auto-played. The bar says why and offers 'Clear prepared'.

shots.heading: Trade: follow or skip, with a warning
shots.caption: Trade can only be prepared as follow or skip, with a visible warning: if the Trade player replenishes you, you are not offered a secondary at all and the prepared answer is dropped.

shots.heading: Setting: Review (default)
shots.caption: The viewer-local switch sits in the player sheet header next to Sound and Toasts. 'Review' is the default for everyone and is stored only when changed.

shots.heading: Setting: Auto
shots.caption: 'Auto' sends a prepared answer for you once your decision opens, only while it still validates, after a short visible delay.

shots.heading: Auto mode: the toast
shots.caption: In Auto mode the window opens and the prepared answer is announced ('Auto-playing your prepared secondary: ...') with a Cancel button for about 2.5 seconds before it is sent. It never fires after an undo, redo, restore, reload or reconnect, from a spectator, or from a second tab.

shots.heading: Phone width
shots.caption: On a 390 px wide screen the panel spans the width under the status bar and scrolls if needed.

shots.heading: Diplomacy: planets
shots.caption: Pick up to two of your exhausted planets to ready. Prepared planets are matched by planet, not by option id.

shots.heading: Construction: site
shots.caption: Pick a PDS or space dock and the planet; at arrival it is matched against the placements the engine offers.

shots.heading: Leadership: purchase plan
shots.caption: Leadership needs no strategy token. Prepare how many tokens to buy (3 influence each) and which pool; at arrival the influence payment is planned and sent as the existing token batch, or flagged if the influence no longer pays for it.

notes.title: Client-only.
notes.text: No server, protocol, history or bot change. A prepared answer is never sent anywhere and never binding; the real answer is an ordinary recorded decision.

notes.title: Which card is in progress.
notes.text: The public turn status does not name the card, so the client reads the public event log (the action selection's 'played <Card>' detail) and, for a seat holding one card, infers it from the primary's single unexhausted card.
